Attribute.Name: Noticeability attribute
Attribute.Hint: The character attribute that sets the recognition radius (as named on the sheet, case-insensitive). A data path such as system.stealth.value works too. Tokens without it are never disguised.

CellsPerPoint.Name: Grid cells per point
CellsPerPoint.Hint: The real token is visible within Noticeability × this many grid cells. At 1, a character with Noticeability 3 is recognised from 3 cells away.

MemorySeconds.Name: Seconds a recognised character is remembered
MemorySeconds.Hint: How many seconds a character keeps recognising someone it saw within the radius after moving away or losing sight of them. In combat, someone recognised stays recognised until the fight ends.

FadeDuration.Name: Transition length (ms)
FadeDuration.Hint: How many milliseconds the real token takes to fade into its disguise and back. 0 swaps at once.

DefaultImage.Name: Default disguise image
DefaultImage.Hint: What is seen in place of a token from afar, when the token has no disguise image of its own.

DefaultName.Name: Default disguise name
DefaultName.Hint: The nameplate of a disguised token that has no disguise name of its own. Empty hides the nameplate.

GMPreview.Name: GM sees through selected tokens
GMPreview.Hint: Normally the GM always sees the real tokens. Turn this on to see the disguises the way the selected tokens see them.

Config.ImageHint: What is seen from outside the recognition radius. Empty uses the module's default image.
Config.Name: Disguise name
Config.NameHint: The nameplate while the token is disguised. Empty uses the module's default name.
